introduction: I'm a Software Engineering student at Addis Ababa University with a strong passion for building technology that solves real-world problems. I combine academics with hands-on project experience across full-stack web development, IoT, and machine learning.

I build end-to-end software solutions, from ESP32 plant disease detection systems with Flask APIs to Next.js finance apps that parse SMS bank transactions to track expenses automatically. I'm currently learning machine learning and integrating TensorFlow and data science tools into my web development workflow.
